title: Fiberwise right adjoints assemble relative to a cocartesian base
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors, transformations and mapping spaces as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], with the universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], enlarged if necessary. Let $p:E\to S$ and $q:D\to S$ be cocartesian fibrations as in [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $F:E\to D$ be a functor over $S$ preserving cocartesian edges. Suppose for every vertex $s$ the fiber functor $F_s:E_s\to D_s$ is equipped with a right adjoint $R_s$. There is a right adjoint $R:D\to E$ over $S$, with coherent unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}_E\to RF$, counit $\varepsilon:FR\to\mathrm{id}_D$ and triangle homotopies over the identity of $S$. Its restriction to each fiber agrees, up to equivalence of adjunction data, with the specified fiber adjunction. In particular, the natural equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}_D(Fx,y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_E(x,Ry)$$
is over $\operatorname{Map}_S(p(x),q(y))$ and restricts to an equivalence on the homotopy fiber over every base arrow. The forward map is $k\mapsto R(k)\eta_x$ and the inverse is $h\mapsto\varepsilon_yF(h)$. These assertions and the adjunction data remain valid after pullback along every functor $S'\to S$.
